title: `field_caps` Throws NPE  when running against `composite` runtime fields

labels.name: :Search Foundations/Mapping
labels.description: Index mappings, including merging and defining field types

labels.name: Team:Search Foundations
labels.description: Meta label for the Search Foundations team in Elasticsearch

body:
Hey y'all, with the awesome addition: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/75108 (which I LOVE)

There seems to be a bug with field caps. 

NPE 1
```json
{
  "error" : {
    "root_cause" : [
      {
        "type" : "null_pointer_exception",
        "reason" : "Cannot invoke \"org.elasticsearch.index.mapper.ObjectMapper.isNested()\" because \"mapper\" is null"
      }
    ],
    "type" : "null_pointer_exception",
    "reason" : "Cannot invoke \"org.elasticsearch.index.mapper.ObjectMapper.isNested()\" because \"mapper\" is null"
  },
  "status" : 500
}
```

NPE 2
```
{
  "error" : {
    "root_cause" : [
      {
        "type" : "null_pointer_exception",
        "reason" : null
      }
    ],
    "type" : "null_pointer_exception",
    "reason" : null
  },
  "status" : 500
}
```

To reproduce:

```
DELETE logs
PUT logs/_mapping
{
  "mappings": {
    "runtime": {
      "log": {
        "type": "composite",
        "script": """emit(grok("%{COMMONAPACHELOG}").extract(doc["message.keyword"].value))""",
        "fields": {
          "clientip": {
            "type": "ip"
          },
          "response": {
            "type": "long"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

GET logs/_field_caps?fields=*
```
